image_urls.description: clean teacher desk setup with laptop

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a stunning, lightning-fast React JS Teacher Administration Dashboard (AbsenSPG / TeacherAdmin Pro) preserving and enhancing all existing features from Apps Script (Attendance with anti-duplicate locks, Grading with formative/sumative categories and Excel import, Class Teaching / Lesson Journal / Jurnal Mengajar, Timetable / Jadwal Mengajar, School Identity settings, Teacher Account Management, Class & Subject management, automated backup triggers, and Report / Rekap exports). Use Tailwind CSS, Shadcn components, lucide-react icons, and Sonner toasts. Ensure data-testid on every interactive element.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Never use pure black or pure white without tinting
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes
Maintain high contrast APCA compliant text
No transparent dropdown or header backgrounds without backdrop-blur
